ammonia.reason: Short ~2-3 week aging limits deamination and proteolysis, no ammonia accumulation.

animal_barnyard.reason: p-Cresol 998 ug/kg (OAV256) fecal phenol from tyrosine plus stable/smoke and sheep-milk pastoral notes.

bitter.reason: Minimal accumulation of hydrophobic bitter peptides in young pasta-filata matrix.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti and no quantified methyl ketones (2-heptanone/2-nonanone absent).

browning.reason: Residual lactose/galactose + lysine plus smoke carbonyls drive Maillard browning on grilling.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl 396 ug/kg (OAV132) from citrate/lactose metabolism by starter LAB retains buttery note despite smoking loss.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Butanoic acid 21.6 mg/kg (OAV9) + 3-methylbutanoic acid 6.6 mg/kg (OAV13.4) from lipolysis and leucine catabolism.

creaminess.reason: Fat 27.6% (FDM 45.5%) moderated by low moisture and firm stretched protein network.

crumbliness.reason: Hot-kneaded aligned paracasein fibers deform rather than fracture.

firmness.reason: Moisture 39% + brining + smoke-dried rind + dense kneaded paracasein gives firm sliceable body.

floral_honey.reason: Phenylacetaldehyde only FD4, no 2-phenylethanol quantified; limited phenylalanine catabolism.

fruity.reason: No quantified ethyl butanoate/hexanoate; short aging limits esterase fruity ester formation.

goaty.reason: Sheep-milk C6:0 caproic 4.6 mg/kg plus branched-chain acids from lipolysis give moderate caprine sharpness.

malty_nutty.reason: Maltol 2093 ug/kg from wood-smoke/heat plus low Strecker aldehydes gives light toasted-nutty note.

melt.reason: pH 5.18 demineralized curd softens/flows on grilling but smoke drying and aging reduce full flow.

mushroom_earthy.reason: 1-octen-3-ol/one not quantified and no surface mold limits linoleate-derived mushroom note.

oil_off.reason: Moderate free fat at 27.6% fat releases some oil on heating without heavy oiling.

smoky.reason: Guaiacol 1075 ug/kg (OAV1280) + 4-methylguaiacol 1979 ug/kg from spruce/pine lignin pyrolysis during prolonged smoking.

sour_vinegar.reason: Acetic acid 188-258 mg/kg (OAV~2.6) from heterofermentative LAB plus smoke-deposited acetate at pH 5.18.

stretch.reason: Pasta-filata hot-water stretching creates aligned fibers that re-extend when grilled.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Methional 1.2 ug/kg (OAV2.8) from methionine Strecker during 65-70C scalding and smoking.

sweet.reason: Residual lactose plus smoke maltol 2093 ug/kg and caramelized carbonyls give light sweetness.

umami.reason: Short rennet aging limits free glutamate and savory peptides.
